name: water elemental
desc: Water Elemental is a CR 5 elemental.

actions.name: freeze
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes cold damage, it partially freezes; its speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: water form
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without &reference[squeezing]{Squeezing}.

actions.name: whelm
actions.desc: Each creature in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s space must make a [[/save activity=wNdhnTTQQLAgCSv9]] saving throw. On a failure, a target takes [[/damage average activity=wNdhnTTQQLAgCSv9]] damage. If it is Large or smaller, it is also &Reference[grappled] (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is &Reference[restrained] and unable to &reference[suffocating]{Breathe} unless it can breathe water. If the saving throw is successful, the target is pushed out of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s space.The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns, each target grappled by it takes [[/damage average activity=3Ed1FjdlOVvPPqS8]] damage. A creature within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a [[/check activity=QoSOLmJfjlxffpld]] check and succeeding.
